clauses.mechanism: successor appointed vice the incumbent Administrator, 'resigned', with the same four earlier orders amended accordingly (EO 9901)
clauses.reason: EO 9618 (signed "September 19,1945.", Filed, Sept. 19, 1945) appoints Edwin G. Arnold as Administrator of the Puerto Rico Reconstruction Administration, "vice Benjamin W. Thoron, resigned," to serve without additional compensation and to exercise the functions conferred by Executive Orders 7057, 7180 (as amended by 7554) and 7689, which "The said Executive orders are hereby" amended accordingly. EO 9901, signed "October 25, 1947." (12 FR 6965), appoints James P. Davis as Administrator, "vice Edwin G. Arnold, resigned, to serve" without additional compensation, gives him the functions conferred by the same four orders, and says that the said Executive orders are amended accordingly. EO 9901 therefore shows that Arnold had resigned and had been replaced no later than October 25, 1947, when the functions conferred on him were conferred on his successor. The date of Arnold's resignation is not held and may be earlier; October 25, 1947 is the latest date by which his appointment and functions had ended and the first date on which a held instrument documents the end, so it is recorded as the first end with that qualification. The appointing words were performed on signing, September 19, 1945; that earlier date is an alternative candidate for the end of the appointing act alone, but the clause also confers functions on the appointee during his service, which ended no later than October 25, 1947. The first-end source is the held Federal Register text of EO 9901 (its provision quoted by the dossier's change record). EO 10018 (1948-11-15) and EO 10468 (1953-07-07) come after this end and do not alter it.

research_rationale:
EO 9618 was read in full in the registered Federal Register text layer (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_9618.txt, 10 FR 11931, PDF page 3); the census register row (date, title, President) agrees with the heading, title and date line printed in that text. The order appoints Edwin G. Arnold, Director, Division of Territories and Island Possessions, Department of the Interior, as Administrator of the Puerto Rico Reconstruction Administration, vice Benjamin W. Thoron, resigned, to serve without additional compensation, and to exercise the functions conferred on the Administration and the Administrator by Executive Orders 7057, 7180 (as amended by 7554) and 7689, which it amends accordingly. Page location was checked against the PDF page markers of the held text layer only; no page image was inspected. The representation is a machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF, held as original_representation_unverified. The appointment is ended by a held successor order that appoints another Administrator 'vice' Arnold and amends the same four orders.

savings.reason: EO 9901 conferred the same functions, duties and authority under Executive Orders 7057, 7180 (as amended by 7554) and 7689 on James P. Davis, so what the order gave Arnold was transferred to his successor; acts done by Arnold as Administrator before then are accrued. No held source shows any continuing command of EO 9618 after that transfer.
